stem: 一家银行使用网络分析工具来识别客户与犯罪实体之间的联系。该系统能够识别潜在的间接关系，但无法对这些关系进行优先级排序。合规官应采取什么措施来提高该工具的有效性？

options.A: 手动审查所有被标记的关系以确保准确无误
options.B: 对间接关联实施风险评分算法
options.C: 整合外部数据库和社交媒体资料，以交叉核对被标记的实体
options.D: 关注客户与犯罪实体之间的直接联系

stem_en: A bank is using a network analysis tool to identify links between its customers and criminal entities. The system identifies potential indirect relationships but is unable to prioritize them. What should the compliance officer do to enhance the tool's effectiveness?

options_en.A: Manually review all flagged relationships for accuracy
options_en.B: Implement risk-scoring algorithms for indirect connections
options_en.C: Integrate external databases and social media profiles to cross-check flagged entities
options_en.D: Focus on direct connections between customers and criminal entities
